blurb: Serving the Gay, Lesbian, Bi, Trans and Queer community, Cedars is situated in 130 unspoiled, partially wooded acres atop the Niagara Escarpment. Cedars Campground is proud to be one of the largest and longest operating campgrounds in North America serving our community.
